title: Notifications
description: Templates, the outbox with delivery status, the development mailbox and your own notification preferences for this product.
descriptionPreferencesOnly: Choose which notifications of this product you want to receive.

contentState.redacted: This template is marked as sensitive, so the content is never shown.
contentState.purged: The content was erased by the retention policy.
contentState.none: No content is stored for this message (for example because it was suppressed by the recipient's preferences).

stats.title: Delivery statistics
stats.description: Messages of this product by status, overall and in the last 24 hours.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Your templates and the built-in defaults. A template with the key of a built-in default replaces it.
templates.emptyBody: Create a template to send notifications from your product.
templates.deleteBody: The template “{{key}}” is deleted. Messages already sent are kept. If a built-in default with this key exists, it is used again.
templates.systemOnlyHint: Axentra sends this template itself (for example the accept link of a tenant invitation), so it cannot be sent manually or as a test. You can still customize its content.
templates.systemOnlyListHint: Templates marked “System only” are sent by Axentra itself and cannot be sent as a test.

editor.descriptionNew: Define the content per language. The preview on the right is rendered by the server with your sample values.
editor.description: Changes are saved as a new version. The preview is rendered by the server with your sample values.
editor.forbidden: You need the permission notify:manage to edit templates.
editor.builtinHint: This is a built-in default. Saving creates your own version with the same key, which replaces the default for this product. Deleting it later restores the default.
editor.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, “_”, “.” and “-”, starting with a letter. Used by your code to send it; cannot be changed later.
editor.keyInvalid: Use 2–63 characters: lowercase letters, digits, “_”, “.” or “-”, starting with a letter.
editor.categoryHelp: Recipients can opt out of categories, except “transactional” and “security”.
editor.channelHelp: Only email is supported by the server at the moment.
editor.sensitiveHelp: For content such as one-time links: the content of sent messages is never shown and is erased once the message is sent.
editor.variablesHelp: Placeholders such as {{placeholder}} may only use declared variables. Sample values are used for the preview.
editor.variableInvalid: Letters, digits and “_”, not starting with a digit.
editor.variantsHelp: English is required and used when no better match exists (de-at → de → en).
editor.htmlHelp: Optional. Values are HTML-escaped by the server. Scripts never run in the preview.
editor.localeInvalid: Use a language code such as “de” or “de-at”.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Rendered by the server from the current, unsaved state.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.noHtml: This version has no HTML body; recipients get the text version.
preview.incomplete: Enter a subject and a text for every language to see the preview.

send.title: Send {{name}}
send.description: Sends a real notification to a member of a tenant or to an address. Delivery happens asynchronously.
send.tenantHelp: The message belongs to this tenant.
send.noPermission: You do not have the permission notify:send in this tenant.
send.memberHelp: The member's language is used unless you choose one.
send.emailHelp: Opt-outs apply if the address belongs to a user.
send.localeHelp: Without a choice, the recipient's language is used, otherwise English.
send.sensitive: This template is sensitive: its content is not shown in the message log.
send.dispatchHint: It is delivered by the dispatcher (axentra notify-dispatch or a worker). Follow its status in the message log.
send.membersOnly: You can send to members of the tenant. Sending to other email addresses needs the product permission notify:send_external (product owners and admins).

messages.title: Message log
messages.description: The outbox: every notification with status, attempts and the last delivery error (sensitive data is redacted by the server).
messages.emptyBody: Messages appear here as soon as your product sends notifications.
messages.redactedHint: Tokens, keys and passwords in error messages are removed by the server.

mailbox.title: Mailbox
mailbox.description: Messages the local development provider has “delivered”. Nothing leaves the server.
mailbox.emptyBody: Delivered messages appear here after the dispatcher has run.
mailbox.unavailableTitle: No local mailbox on this server
mailbox.unavailableBody: The mailbox exists only with the local development provider. This server delivers with “{{provider}}”, so messages go to real recipients; follow them in the message log.
mailbox.unavailableBodyUnknown: The mailbox exists only with the local development provider (notify.provider = "local"). This server uses another provider.

preferences.title: My notification preferences
preferences.description: Choose which categories you want to receive. They apply to notifications sent to you from now on.
preferences.scopeHelp: Product-wide, or only for one tenant.
preferences.locked: Always delivered; cannot be turned off.
preferences.emptyBody: Categories appear once the product has templates.

info.category: 2–41 lowercase letters, digits or “_”. A category appears in recipients’ preferences as soon as a template uses it.
info.html: A value inserted into a link (href) controls where the link points. Keep links in the template or build them in your backend.
info.status: Queued: waiting for the dispatcher. Sending: being delivered. Sent: accepted by the provider. Failed: permanent error or all attempts used. Suppressed: the recipient opted out or has no email address.
info.oldestQueued: A separate dispatcher process delivers the messages. If this time keeps growing, no dispatcher is running.
info.scope: Categories turned off for the whole product stay off in every tenant. A tenant setting can only turn off more categories.
